items.title: A point is closed in its fibre exactly when its residue field extension over the base is finite
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes closedness of a point in its fibre for a locally finite type morphism by finiteness of the residue field extension (statement lines 3813-3821). The counted proof is short and complete: one direction is the cited criterion, and for the converse it chooses affine charts so that the relevant ring map is of finite type, forms the fibre ring, notes that closedness of the point translates into maximality of a prime of that ring, and applies the Nullstellensatz to get the finite residue field extension (proof lines 3823-3847). It is H2: the argument is carried out in the counted span and its only inputs are the affine characterization and the Nullstellensatz.
